utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tess, I’ve got Noah down for one roll of tape and two pairs of gloves, and I’m still leaving trash bags unchecked until he confirms.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Cleo—that matches what I’ve been hearing, so leave the trash bags open for now and I’ll keep nudging folks on the rest of the repair drive timing and signups.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good—Noah stays at one roll of tape and two pairs of gloves on my list, with trash bags still unchecked until he confirms.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Jules is checking both sides of the block this afternoon, and I’m still spreading the word while I’m out, so the repair drive should get a solid turnout.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That helps a lot—when Jules finishes, send me which houses confirmed on each side, and I’ll log them by stretch while I’m still waiting on Quinn’s Maple and Cedar updates.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do—I’ll pass along which houses Jules confirms on each side once I hear back, and I’m still mentioning the repair drive while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then let’s stop guessing—who do you trust to know for sure, and can we call them about the clipboard and the signup list right now?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Honestly, I’d trust Rey to know for sure since they’re bringing the list, so yes—let’s call Rey now and ask who has the clipboard and whether they’ve started going door to door.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—call Rey now and put it on speaker; if they don’t answer, who’s our second call?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m putting that list together now—tools, pickup times, storage spot, what folks should bring, and when the repair drive starts. I’ll bring it by after so we can look it over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Rey—put my ladder and drill set aside on there, and tell Pia I’ve still got them ready if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Alright, I’ll add your ladder and drill set to the list, and I’ll let Pia know they’re ready if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m making the rounds on Maple and Cedar this afternoon for the repair drive, Uli, and I’ll pass along the houses that say yes once I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll still come by the community center, just a bit quiet today.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries, Uli—I’ll keep spreading the word on Maple and Cedar this afternoon and send along the yeses once they come in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can swing by right after drop-off to check the sorted tools and see where we stand on trash bags, then come back before pickup if you still need coverage.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a good, clear plan, Faye. Check the sorted tools and trash bags after drop-off, then come back before pickup, and let me know what still needs covering.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll check in right after drop-off and let you know what we’re short on, then swing back before pickup if anything still needs covering.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive, sorry, I blanked for a second. We’re still meeting by the community center, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, still the community center, and I’m handling the tool pickup first before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, thanks—sorry, I blanked for a second. I’ll head to the community center then, unless you need me to check on anything before you get there.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before we lock anything in, do we know whether Quinn is definitely managing the signup list, and who had the clipboard last?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s exactly why I’m uneasy—I need one clear list with who’s managing signups, who has the clipboard, pickup times, and where the tools are being stored before we lock anything in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m with you—before we decide anything, should we check with Quinn first on the signup list and ask who last signed out the clipboard?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m just catching up, Bo — Quinn’s got the signup confirmations, so let’s check with them about the clipboard and keep Mara on tool sorting for now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, that works—have Quinn handle the clipboard, and I’ll just skim Rosa’s list later and flag anything that jumps out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo—that helps; once Quinn confirms the clipboard, let me know if Rosa’s list turns up anything we should handle before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think Cleo’s got me down for a roll of tape and two pairs of gloves, but I’m still not sure about the trash bags.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds right to me—bring the tape and gloves, and if you’ve got trash bags handy, toss a few in too; it all starts this afternoon for the repair drive, and Ira’s the point person if you want to double-check the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, this afternoon—thanks. I’ll bring the tape and gloves, and I’ll check on the trash bags if I can remember.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Leo, I’m already sorting the donated tools and setting aside anything that needs parts, and I’ll keep track of what we’re missing. If you know any homes that should be added for Sunday at the community center, tell me and I’ll pass them to Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I don’t have any extra homes to add right now. I’m still good for Saturday around 10 at the community center, hauling only.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Leo — Saturday around 10 for hauling is a big help, and I’ll keep you posted if anything shifts once I finish sorting the tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Rosa, can you confirm Tess is still set to keep the rest of the repair drive lined up once Sam has the tools?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — Tess is still lined up to keep the rest of the repair drive moving once Sam has the tools, and just note it’s now happening Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, thanks for confirming—are we certain Sam’s tool pickup still lines up cleanly with that Sunday timing?
